How this project uses My Avatar Editor (see License.txt and README.txt, which are the original files)

- myavatarcharacter.swf and myavatareditor.swf are copied unchanged from the 1.0.5.0 source download
  (bin/ folder). scripts/59_export_mii_art.py reads them and writes the art into native/launcher/mii_art.cpp.
- native/launcher/mii_render.cpp follows the placement, palettes, and lookup tables of
  src/com/myavatareditor/fla/character/AvatarCharacter.as and AvatarBody.as.
- The build copies License.txt to exports/native-build/licenses/MyAvatarEditor.txt, and the launcher's Mii Maker
  credits the art on its list page.
